questions.question_text: Evaluate $\arccos(-0.8)$ using a calculator. Give your answer in radians correct to three decimal places.

questions.solution_text:
$\arccos(-0.8)=\pi-\arccos(0.8)=2.498091544\ldots$.
Keeping full precision until the final rounding gives $2.498$ radians to three decimal places.

questions.question_text: A right-angled triangle has hypotenuse $3$ and a side of length $3x$, where $0<x<1$. The acute angle opposite this side is $A$, and the other acute angle is $B$. Which deduction follows from the triangle?

options.why: Used the angle sum of the whole triangle without subtracting its right angle.
Treated the other acute angle as the negative of $A$ instead of its complement.
Subtracted the acute angles instead of adding them to obtain the complement of the right angle.

questions.solution_text:
$\sin A=\frac{3x}{3}=x$, so $A=\arcsin x$.
$\cos B=\frac{3x}{3}=x$, so $B=\arccos x$.
The acute angles satisfy $A+B=\frac{\pi}{2}$, giving $\arcsin x+\arccos x=\frac{\pi}{2}$.
